user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene: Mars Colony Base. A Martian colony under a butterscotch sky: interconnected habitat domes with airlocks, a six-wheeled rover parked by a charging mast, solar panel arrays angled at the sun, a communications dish, greenhouse dome glowing green from within, red dunes and scattered boulders, rover tracks in the dust, a distant dust devil, and two small moons overhead. Style: nasa-punk sci-fi. Entirely procedural geometry and textures (no external assets; canvas-generated textures are allowed). Compose a full environment — ground/backdrop plus several distinct focal structures and rich supporting props — with style-appropriate materials, a deliberate lighting rig with shadows, atmospheric depth (fog or a gradient sky where fitting), and subtle looping animation on at least three elements. Include OrbitControls with gentle auto-rotate, ACES filmic tone mapping, and a seeded PRNG so the layout is reproducible. Target roughly 600-700 lines of well-organized code.
